written_by: Claude Code, for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: Computer Science for Explore (spec 21), batch 1. Every name and description is in Stackd's own words; nothing is copied from UC's page. C-ID numbers, the template number and revision, the degree name, the unit totals and the campus major names are copied exactly. UC pathway: the Computer Science Transfer Pathway page on admission.universityofcalifornia.edu (it states no term or year; academic_year is the year it was checked). TMC: Template #2007, Rev. 3: 10/14/16, the PDF in source_url. The same course list is in the current Cal-GETC ADT submission form (https://www.cccco.edu/-/media/CCCCO-Website/docs/curriculum/computerscirevform.docx), which shows the major as 28-29 units because one option is 5 units; major_units is the template's minimum, 28. The templates page (Templates For Approved Transfer Model Curriculum on cccco.edu) labels both files 'Rev 1: 10/14/2016', but the files themselves say Rev. 3. Topics: cs1, cs2, comp-org, discrete and calculus-single appear in both pathways (Counts for both, 5 of 9). Physics is kept apart: UC asks for a year (physics-year), the TMC for the first course (physics-mechanics). Check every row against its source, delete each todo once confirmed, fill in retrieved_at on both pathways, then run: npm run import -- data/raw/explore/computer-science.json --dry-run
